method: Every piece with a Royal Perfect head source (data/perfect-head-sources.json) was looked at beside its hair-recoloured version. Pieces at or above the threshold get Royal Perfect's head unless rejected here. Every rebuilt piece was also checked for blond hair lost in its head window (more dark pixels or fewer blond ones than the recolour); those that look worse are rejected.
